_doc: Director-authored Steam User Stats for player analytics (demo app 5575620 first). Every stat is INT, set by client, increment only, min 0, default 0. player_flag: max 1, aggregated, so the global sum counts players. counter: aggregated sum. player_value: per-account helper, not aggregated. Names never change once published; add play_v2_* for new meanings.

stats.name: play_v1_p_launched
stats.when: The main menu finishes loading.

stats.name: play_v1_p_run_started
stats.when: A new run starts (not a resume).

stats.name: play_v1_p_fight_won
stats.when: The player wins any fight.

stats.name: play_v1_p_fight3
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number >= 3.

stats.name: play_v1_p_fight5
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number >= 5.

stats.name: play_v1_p_guardian
stats.when: A fight starts in a room_type 'guardian' room.

stats.name: play_v1_p_boss
stats.when: A fight starts in a room_type 'boss' room.

stats.name: play_v1_p_boss_won
stats.when: A run ends with outcome 'victory'.

stats.name: play_v1_p_run2
stats.when: A new run starts and this account's play_v1_runs_started is now >= 2.

stats.name: play_v1_p_run_after_win
stats.display: Players: played on after a win
stats.when: A new run starts and this account's play_v1_runs_won is >= 1.

stats.name: play_v1_p_day2
stats.when: The game launches on a later UTC day than play_v1_first_day.

stats.name: play_v1_p_day7
stats.display: Players: came back a week later
stats.when: The game launches 7 or more UTC days after play_v1_first_day.

stats.name: play_v1_p_wishlist
stats.when: Any Wishlist button or link is pressed.

stats.name: play_v1_p_discord
stats.when: Any Discord or feedback link is pressed.

stats.name: play_v1_p_gamepad
stats.when: Any gamepad button press, or stick/trigger motion past the deadzone.

stats.name: play_v1_p_os_windows
stats.when: Launched on Windows.

stats.name: play_v1_p_os_macos
stats.when: Launched on macOS.

stats.name: play_v1_p_os_linux
stats.when: Launched on Linux and not on a Steam Deck.

stats.name: play_v1_p_os_steamdeck
stats.when: Launched on a Steam Deck (Steam reports it); never also counts as Linux.

stats.name: play_v1_first_day
stats.when: Set once, at the first launch where it is still 0, to the current UTC day number. Never changed again.

stats.name: play_v1_sessions
stats.when: The main menu finishes loading after an app launch (once per launch).

stats.name: play_v1_play_minutes
stats.when: +1 for each full minute the game window has focus.

stats.name: play_v1_run_minutes
stats.when: +1 for each full minute of the existing run play clock (the one the Chronicle reports).

stats.name: play_v1_runs_started
stats.when: A new run starts (not a resume).

stats.name: play_v1_runs_resumed
stats.when: Continue loads a saved run.

stats.name: play_v1_runs_won
stats.when: A run ends with outcome 'victory'.

stats.name: play_v1_runs_died
stats.when: A run ends with outcome 'defeat'.

stats.name: play_v1_runs_withdrew
stats.when: A run ends with outcome 'embrace'.

stats.name: play_v1_runs_abandoned
stats.when: A saved, unfinished run is discarded by the player (New Game over a save, or Abandon run).

stats.name: play_v1_runs_reached_boss
stats.when: A fight starts in a room_type 'boss' room (once per run).

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_1
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number == 1.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_2
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number == 2.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_3
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number == 3.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_4
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number == 4.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_5
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number == 5.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_6
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number == 6.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_started_7
stats.when: A fight starts with fight_number >= 7.

stats.name: play_v1_fights_won
stats.when: The player wins a fight.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_1
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number == 1.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_2
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number == 2.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_3
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number == 3.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_4
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number == 4.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_5
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number == 5.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_6
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number == 6.

stats.name: play_v1_died_fight_7
stats.display: Runs lost in fight 7 or later
stats.when: A run is lost during the fight with fight_number >= 7.

stats.name: play_v1_died_combat
stats.display: Runs lost in a normal fight
stats.when: A run is lost during a fight whose room_type is 'combat'.

stats.name: play_v1_died_special
stats.display: Runs lost in a special room fight
stats.when: A run is lost during a fight whose room_type is 'special'.

stats.name: play_v1_died_guardian
stats.display: Runs lost in a Guardian fight
stats.when: A run is lost during a fight whose room_type is 'guardian'.

stats.name: play_v1_died_boss
stats.display: Runs lost in the dragon fight
stats.when: A run is lost during a fight whose room_type is 'boss'.

stats.name: play_v1_died_other
stats.when: A run is lost while no fight is in progress.

stats.name: play_v1_tutorial_started
stats.when: The guided first-fight tutorial starts.

stats.name: play_v1_tutorial_left_early
stats.when: The guided tutorial ends before its final step (skipped, dismissed or abandoned).

stats.name: play_v1_quit_menu
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on the main menu (including its Chronicle, Grimoire and Settings).

stats.name: play_v1_quit_map
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on the room map or room travel.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_fight
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on a fight (pre-battle or combat, including overlays opened from it).

stats.name: play_v1_quit_reward
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on post-fight rewards.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_event
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on a map event, mystery, dialogue or rest.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_shop
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on a merchant.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_run_end
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on the run-end or demo-end panel.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_other
stats.when: A clean quit (Quit button, window close, Alt+F4, Steam's Exit Game) while the player is on any other screen.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_midrun_f0_1
stats.when: A clean quit while a run is in progress (map, fight, reward, event or shop) and that run has started 0-1 fights.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_midrun_f2_3
stats.when: A clean quit while a run is in progress (map, fight, reward, event or shop) and that run has started 2-3 fights.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_midrun_f4_5
stats.when: A clean quit while a run is in progress (map, fight, reward, event or shop) and that run has started 4-5 fights.

stats.name: play_v1_quit_midrun_f6p
stats.display: Clean quits mid-run after 6 or more fights
stats.when: A clean quit while a run is in progress (map, fight, reward, event or shop) and that run has started 6 or more fights.

stats.name: play_v1_sess_lt5
stats.when: A session ends (launch to quit, wall clock) lasting under 5 min. Unclean sessions are counted at the next launch from the last minute the marker recorded.

stats.name: play_v1_sess_5_15
stats.when: A session ends (launch to quit, wall clock) lasting 5-15 min. Unclean sessions are counted at the next launch from the last minute the marker recorded.

stats.name: play_v1_sess_15_30
stats.when: A session ends (launch to quit, wall clock) lasting 15-30 min. Unclean sessions are counted at the next launch from the last minute the marker recorded.

stats.name: play_v1_sess_30_60
stats.when: A session ends (launch to quit, wall clock) lasting 30-60 min. Unclean sessions are counted at the next launch from the last minute the marker recorded.

stats.name: play_v1_sess_60p
stats.when: A session ends (launch to quit, wall clock) lasting 60 min or more. Unclean sessions are counted at the next launch from the last minute the marker recorded.

stats.name: play_v1_unclean_exits
stats.display: Sessions that ended without a clean quit
stats.when: The next launch finds the previous session never quit cleanly (crash, force quit, power loss).

stats.name: play_v1_load_errors
stats.display: Saved run or profile failed to load
stats.when: A saved run or the profile fails to load and the player sees the load-error cover.

stats.name: play_v1_save_errors
stats.when: A profile or run checkpoint save fails (the existing failure paths).

stats.name: play_v1_wishlist_end
stats.display: Wishlist pressed on the end panel
stats.when: Wishlist pressed on the end panel.

stats.name: play_v1_wishlist_menu
stats.display: Wishlist pressed on the menu or settings
stats.when: Wishlist pressed on the menu or settings.

stats.name: play_v1_discord_end
stats.display: Discord/Feedback pressed on the end panel
stats.when: Discord/Feedback pressed on the end panel.

stats.name: play_v1_discord_menu
stats.display: Discord pressed on the menu or settings
stats.when: Discord pressed on the menu or settings.

stats.name: play_v1_rise_again
stats.when: Rise Again pressed.
